semiconductor_relevance: High — NTS Technology specializes in laser processing systems that are crucial for semiconductor manufacturing and thin film applications.
summary: NTS Technology Co., Ltd. is a system integrator focused on laser processing technologies, located in Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan. Their proprietary control systems enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and quality of laser direct imaging, addressing challenges in laser circuit dry etching and thin film patterning.
capabilities: Laser direct imaging systems for thin film materials
Real-time coordination of mechanics, electrics, laser, and optics
Thin film material processing including ITO and conductive polymers

regional_presence.Taiwan: NTS Technology is based in Hsinchu Science Park, a key hub for semiconductor innovation and manufacturing.
